questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Sudha said, 'Vivek arrived on Friday.'

options.text: Sudha said that Vivek had arrived on Friday
Sudha said that Vivek had been arrived on Friday.
Sudha said that Vivek arrives on Friday.
Sudha said that Vivek was being arrived on Friday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech, the tense of the verb often changes one step back into the past.
 
• Since the reporting verb "**said**" is in the past tense, "**arrived**" changes to "**had arrived**" to reflect this step back in tense.
 
• Therefore, "**Vivek arrived on Friday**" becomes "**Vivek had arrived on Friday**" in indirect speech.
 
• Options 2, 3, and 4 contain grammatical errors, so they can be ruled out.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Sudha said that Vivek had arrived on Friday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Sudha said that Vivek had been arrived on Friday." **– This option is incorrect because "had been arrived" is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3: "Sudha said that Vivek arrives on Friday."** – This option is incorrect because "arrives" is in the present tense and does not reflect the change to past perfect tense.
 
• **Option 4: "Sudha said that Vivek was being arrived on Friday."** – This option is incorrect because "was being arrived" is not grammatically correct.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Drug addiction is fatal ___________ of therapy, which includes therapies, counselling, medications, and rehab facilities.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**regardless**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence needs a word that indicates that drug addiction can be fatal no matter how much therapy is provided.
 
• The correct word should convey the idea that the fatality of drug addiction does not depend on the presence of therapy.
 
• "**Regardless**" fits well because it means 'in spite of' or 'without being affected by' the therapy.
 
• Other options ("**instead**", "**nonetheless**", "**careless**") do not fit the context and meaning required in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *Drug addiction is fatal **regardless__** of therapy, which includes therapies, counselling, medications, and rehab facilities.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Instead**: "Instead" means as an alternative, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Nonetheless**: "Nonetheless" means in spite of that, which changes the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Careless**: "Careless" means not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors, which is irrelevant in this context.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

She is preparing the presentation for the meeting.

options.text: The presentation by her is being prepared for the meeting.
She is being prepared the presentation for the meeting.
The presentation is preparing by her for the meeting.
The presentation is being prepared by her for the meeting.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in active voice: "She is preparing the presentation for the meeting."
 
• In passive voice, the object (the presentation) becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• The verb "**is preparing**" changes to "**is being prepared**" to indicate the action is being done to the subject.
 
• The original subject (she) follows the verb in a prepositional phrase starting with "**by**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4: The presentation is being prepared by her for the meeting.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: "The presentation by her is being prepared for the meeting." – This is incorrect because the placement of "by her" is awkward and not standard passive voice construction.
 
• **Option 2**: "She is being prepared the presentation for the meeting." – This is incorrect because it improperly constructs the passive voice, making the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3**: "The presentation is preparing by her for the meeting." – This is incorrect because "is preparing" should be "is being prepared" to correctly form the passive voice.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fertility
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Dryness**.

__
 
• The word **"fertility"** means the quality of being able to produce offspring, crops, etc.; it refers to the capability of producing abundant vegetation or offspring. (उर्वरता)

 
 
• **Example: **The **fertility **of the soil ensured a good harvest year after year.
 
 
 
• **"Dryness"** refers to the state or condition of being dry, lacking moisture, or being unproductive. (सूखापन)
 
 
• **Example: **The drought caused severe **dryness **in the region, making it difficult to grow crops.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'fertility'** is **'dryness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Fruitfulness** (फलदायकता): The quality of producing good results or being productive.

 
 
• **Example:** The **fruitfulness **of the project was evident in the high returns and satisfied stakeholders.
 
 
 
• **Tenderness** (मुलायमता): The quality of being gentle, loving, or kind.
 
 
• **Example: **The **tenderness **with which she cared for the old man was touching.
 
 
 
• **Innovation** (नवाचार): The action or process of innovating or introducing new ideas or methods.
 
 
• **Example:** The company's commitment to **innovation **has kept it at the forefront of the tech industry.
